body:
Cedar Sync monthly digest — fixture day 540, 2028-06-27.

Adopted the quota restoration evaluation begun on day 240. Current measurement-16 verifies revision-4 production exposure and a mature 14-day sustained recovery window: 300 requests/minute, effective quota 500/minute, HTTP 429 rate 0.3%, HTTP 401 rate zero. Day-240 measurement-10 separately recorded quota 100/minute, 18% 429 and the provider quota-reduction audit at the same reported demand. The immediate revision-4 recovery measurement-13 was immature; current sustained evidence now supports adoption. Settlement effect-17 and independent status confirm the retained configuration {quota_per_minute:500, retry_jitter:false}, no active experiment and four related evaluations remaining.

The current signal mentions another merged retry-jitter PR, but current production evidence confirms no exposure to the merged PR. Its merge does not support a revert or rollout. The signal age is 540 days; it does not independently establish a fresh alert. Related footer work remains compatible. No new measurement correction was supplied today, and historical revisions were not pooled. Historical inc-61 quota causality and inc-77 authentication-header failure remain separate.

The shared project-credit-ledger remains 9 of 10 validation credits consumed, no reset; this session used zero. No new deployment was required. Residual errors remain at 0.3%; raw denominators, account/burst distributions and sync backlog/latency are unavailable. Evidence covers the supplied 14-day sustained window, not uninterrupted recovery across the entire 300-day gap since restoration. No unobserved intervening sessions are assumed.

Responsibility remains active. Next monitoring is confirmed for fixture day 570, 2028-07-27, by schedule effect-18 and independent status. Review actual revision/PR exposure, effective quota and demand, separate 429/401 rates, new signals and any measurement correction; investigate supported regressions and check report_due. No owner decision or pause is needed. Evidence and the current handoff are retained under memory/.
